Proposal text: The proposed renovation and refurbishment of Clifton House Gate Lodge incorporating installation of loft and cavity wall insulation, specialist repairs to the existing sliding sash windows, specialist repairs to the existing front and patio doors, installation of secondary glazing, cleaning of external brickwork with localized repointing, cleaning of the chimneys with localized repairs, specialist repairs to the modillioned painted timber eaves cornicing, replacement of the existing rainwater goods, replacement of kitchen and bathroom and internal redecoration of walls, floors ceilings and internal doors.
observed_change: Official planning-statistics row records listed-building consent for renovation and refurbishment works at Clifton House Gate Lodge, 2 North Queen Street.
